List what a pull needs decided at chart review

Source: R/master_review.R
review_list.Rd

Every unit a criterion routed to review (undetermined = "review"), and every unit still in the cohort for each review_criterion(). The list holds unit identifiers. Keep it with the study's other restricted files, and never print it to a shared log.

Usage

review_list(pull)

Arguments

pull

A master_pull from pull_master().

Value

A data frame with cohort_unit and criterion_id.

See also

apply_review()
